name: tokens
title: Gamestage tokens
description: The design tokens every Gamestage component reads: colour, type, depth, motion, sound and haptic intent, plus the arcade theme. Install this first. Components read these variables and never define a colour themselves, so a theme change reaches every surface. It also ships the shared rule sets a component includes so a theme axis reaches it without the component re-declaring every property by hand; those land beside the components, at components/gamestage/gamestage-primitives.css, because that is where the components import them from, and every component depends on this item so the file is always there. Renders nothing, creates no DOM and sets no root attribute. It supplies CSS variables, and sound and haptic intent as JSON; it does not play a sound or fire a haptic, and it is the host that sets the theme and context attributes on its own DOM. It pulls in `fonts` as a registry dependency, whose stylesheet is imported before this one.
docs: Import gamestage-tokens.css and gamestage-motion.css once at the root, tokens first. gamestage-primitives.css lands beside the components and each component that needs it imports it itself, so there is nothing to do at the root unless you install tokens on its own, in which case import components/gamestage/gamestage-primitives.css too: it carries the rule that paints the element holding data-gs-theme. Set data-gs-theme="arcade" for the arcade look and data-gs-context="light" for a light surface. motion.css carries the design's eleven keyframes and applies one to any element carrying data-gs-motion; without it a score that should pop and a wrong answer that should shake simply appear.
